d: The scene represents the hall of the Senate, at the bottom of which some arches see the covered Lido of People waiting for festive landing of Otello. Ships in distance. Doge, Elmiro and Senators seated, then Otello, Jago, Rodrigo, and Lucio followed by the Schiere.
Room in Elmiro's palace. Desdemona, Emilia.
He publishes a magnificently adorned hall. Damigelle Choir. Friends Choir, and Elmiro Trusts.
Elmiro, Desdemona, Emilia and Rodrigo with his Séguito.
Othello at the bottom of the theater, followed by some of his Companions, and sayings.
Garden in the house of Othello. Othello seated in the utmost consternation.
Damigelle's choir, in the choir of Confidenti, then Elmiro.
The scene represents a bedroom. Emilia, Desdemona in simple clothes abandoned on a chair, and immersed in the most proud pain.
Desdemona in the greatest pain directs the following prayer to heaven.
Othello enters Desdemona's room for a secret door, holding a torch in his hand, and a dagger.
Doge, Elmiro and Rodrigo with Séguito, and sayings.
